channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-134699 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-134700 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows scene commands to reference PROTO sub-graph nodes freed by a scene replace command. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that causes gf_node_get_field() and gf_node_unregister() to access freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-134701 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-134702 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in curve2d_check_changes() that casts a Curve2D point field node to M_Coordinate2D without type checking. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BIFS scene placing another node type such as LinearGradient in that field, causing an invalid pointer read that crashes the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134703 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an improper Unicode handling vulnerability in DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16 conversion functions in xmltok.c that can split valid surrogate pairs when output space is limited. In XML_UNICODE builds parsing non-native byte order UTF-16 input, attackers can supply crafted documents that deliver lone high surrogates to character data and default handlers.

item.title: CVE-2026-134704 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-134623 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A flaw has been found in Microweber up to 2.0.20. This impacts the function UserManager::make_logged of the file src/MicroweberPackages/App/Http/Controllers/ApiController.php of the component Generic API Dispatcher. This manipulation causes improper access controls. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.21 will fix this issue. Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-134651 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | A flaw was found in Quay. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker holding a restricted, short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) to achieve privilege escalation. Because Quay improperly accepts scoped registry bearer tokens as valid robot account passwords, an attacker can authenticate directly as the robot account and obtain broader permissions. Consequently, unauthorized access persists and enables the attacker to generate fresh tokens even after the robot account's password has been reset.

item.title: CVE-2026-105394 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster WordPress plugin before 1.4.0.7 does not restrict which origins it reflects into its cross-origin resource sharing response headers and pairs the reflected origin with credentialed access, allowing a page on a related origin to read a logged-in user's authenticated content across origins.

item.title: CVE-2026-107592 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform any capability or nonce check in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user with a minimal role such as Subscriber to change the publisher assigned to any book, including books created by other users, and to create new book records. The missing nonce check also makes the action exploitable via CSRF against any logged-in user.

item.title: CVE-2026-107593 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions and protects it only with a nonce that it outputs to every authenticated user on all admin pages, allowing any logged-in user, including Subscribers, to trigger a site-wide rewrite of stored book purchase links and change a related Mooberry Book Manager WordPress plugin through 4.16.2 option.

item.title: CVE-2026-123068 - NVD - CVSS: não informado

item.title: CVE-2026-132814 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Sunday 22 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WPO365 | SEAMLESS WORDPRESS + MICROSOFT INTEGRATION (WPO365 | LOGIN) WordPress plugin before 45.0 does not verify that a Microsoft ID token was issued for the site's own application and tenant when multi-tenant sign-in is enabled with an empty list of allowed tenants, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, with a token Microsoft issued to an application they control.
